description.value: I-Hos Gallery is a K'ómoks First Nation-owned gallery situated on the site of the original K'ómoks Village in the Comox Valley, overlooking the Comox Glacier on Vancouver Island. It presents traditional and contemporary Pacific Northwest Coast artwork hand-crafted by over 50 Indigenous artists, including masks, carvings, jewellery, prints, and woven cedar pieces. Voted Comox Valley's best art gallery in both 2024 and 2025, it also operates a satellite exhibition space at the Cumberland Visitor Information Centre.
